Class Shaman

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.Cards.Card
it.polimi.ingsw.model.CharacterCards.Shaman
All Implemented Interfaces:
TribeDeck
public class Shaman extends Card implements TribeDeck
Represents a Shaman character card within the game.

Shaman cards are specialized characters that contribute mystical or spiritual power to a tribe. Each Shaman card carries a specific number of shamanic stars which, upon recruitment, are immediately added to the player's tribe-wide shamanic attributes tracker to unlock or boost corresponding mechanics.

    • Shaman

      public Shaman(String id, int era, int minPlayer, boolean isObtainable, int shamanStars)
      Constructs a Shaman card with the specified generic card attributes and its star power value.
      Parameters:
      id - the unique string identifier of the card
      era - the historical era or round number this card belongs to
      minPlayer - the minimum number of players required in the game for this card to be included
      isObtainable - true if the card can currently be acquired by players, false otherwise
      shamanStars - the number of shamanic stars/points provided by this card

    • applyTo

      public void applyTo(Player p)
      Applies this Shaman card to the specified player by anchoring it within their tribe's collection.

      This execution implements double-dispatch via the TribeDeck interface, routing the call to the overloaded addCard(Shaman) method inside the player's tribe. This automatically updates the tribe's total star count within its shamanic attributes tracker.

      Specified by:
